tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('inventory.csv')
eip = df[df['resource_kind']=='elastic_ip'].copy()
unassoc = eip[(eip['state']=='unassociated') & (eip['attached_to'].isna())]
print(unassoc[['resource_id','account','region','state','attached_to','monthly_cost_usd']].to_string(index=False))
print("count:", len(unassoc))
print("cross-check state-only:", sorted(eip[eip['state']=='unassociated']['resource_id'].tolist()))
print("cross-check attached_to-null:", sorted(eip[eip['attached_to'].isna()]['resource_id'].tolist()))
print("total cost:", unassoc['monthly_cost_usd'].sum())
result = {"resource_ids": sorted(unassoc['resource_id'].tolist())}
print(result)
